market_question: Will ByteDance have the highest IPO Market Cap 2026?
reasoning: ByteDance's private valuation ($200B+) makes it the most valuable unicorn globally; if it IPOs in 2026 (estimated ~15% chance despite regulatory headwinds), it is extremely likely to be the largest IPO by market cap. The current market price of 0.2% drastically underestimates this probability, creating a large edge.
evidence_points: ByteDance was valued at ~$268B in a 2023 share buyback and remains the world's most valuable private company, dwarfing other IPO candidates.
Regulatory delays in China have repeatedly stalled ByteDance's IPO plans, but no definitive prohibition exists, leaving a non-trivial chance of a 2026 listing.
In 2026, no other private company (SpaceX/Starlink at ~$150B, Stripe at ~$50B) appears likely to surpass ByteDance's market cap on debut.
Historical mega-IPOs (e.g., Saudi Aramco) show that outsized market caps can occur, but none larger than ByteDance's expected valuation are on the horizon.
sources_consulted: Recent news and analyst reports on ByteDance IPO timeline (Bloomberg, Reuters 2023-2024)
Public valuation estimates for ByteDance, SpaceX/Starlink, Stripe, and other large private companies
